general.q: How much can I earn donating plasma?
general.a: New donors can earn up to $115 per donation, while returning donors typically earn $40-$60 per donation. Monthly earnings range from $240 to $920 depending on donation frequency and current promotions.

general.q: How often can I donate plasma?
general.a: You can donate plasma up to two times per week, with at least 48 hours between donations. Most donors average 8 donations per month.
Yes, plasma donation is safe. All centers use sterile, single-use equipment and follow strict FDA guidelines. Donors receive a medical screening before their first donation.

general.q: How long does a plasma donation take?
general.a: The first visit takes 2-3 hours including screening. Subsequent donations typically take 60-90 minutes.
Yes, plasma donation compensation is considered taxable income by the IRS. You will receive a Form 1099-NEC if your earnings exceed $600 in a calendar year.

biolife.q: How much does BioLife pay per donation?
biolife.a: BioLife pays new donors approximately $115 per donation and returning donors approximately $60 per donation. Rates vary by location and current promotions.

biolife.q: How much can I earn at BioLife per month?
biolife.a: New donors at BioLife can earn up to $920 per month by donating 8 times. Returning donors typically earn $240-$480 per month.

biolife.q: Does BioLife have new donor bonuses?
biolife.a: Yes, BioLife frequently offers new donor bonuses. First-time donors earn premium rates, typically around $115 per donation during their introductory period.

csl.q: How much does CSL Plasma pay?
csl.a: CSL Plasma pays new donors approximately $100 per donation and returning donors approximately $50 per donation. Rates vary by location.

csl.q: How much can I earn at CSL Plasma per month?
csl.a: New donors at CSL Plasma can earn up to $800 per month. Returning donors typically earn $200-$400 per month depending on frequency.

octapharma.a: Octapharma pays new donors approximately $90 per donation and returning donors approximately $55 per donation.

octapharma.q: How much can I earn at Octapharma per month?
octapharma.a: New donors at Octapharma can earn up to $720 per month. Returning donors typically earn $220-$440 per month.
